Column.description: One column of the table, described as a variable.

applies_when.description: Condition under which the column has a value, as the source writes it, for example REDCap branching logic. Rows that do not meet it are missing by design.

closed.description: True if values lists every code the column may hold, apart from missing values. A list taken from data is not closed.

completeness.description: Share of the rows that have a value, between 0 and 1.

description.description: Definition of the dataset, column or value.

group.description: Name of the group of columns that the column belongs to, for example the form of a REDCap field.

identifying.description: True if the values identify a person or a record: names, record numbers, contact details. Such a column needs care when the data are shared or synthesized.

label.description: Human-readable name of the column or value.

maximum.description: Largest number the column may hold, apart from missing values.

minimum.description: Smallest number the column may hold, apart from missing values. A limit of the source, not the smallest number found.

missing_values.description: Codes that mean no value and have no label.

name.description: Header of the column, exactly as in the table.

observed.description: Codes found in the data, in order of first occurrence, with their counts. They say what occurred, not what is allowed.

source.description: IRI of a web page that documents the column or its variable.

unit.description: Unit as text, for example years.

unit_iri.description: IRI of the unit, for example from QUDT.

values.description: Codes the column may hold, with their labels. Other codes may occur unless closed is true.

variable.description: IRI of the variable concept the column measures.

Column.title: Column

Count.description: A code found in the data and how often it occurs.

code.description: The code as stored in the table, as text.

count.description: How many rows hold the code.

Count.title: Count

Datatype.description: Storage type, named as in CSV on the Web.
Datatype.title: Datatype

Level.description: Level of measurement, as defined by DSV.
Level.title: Level

Mapping.description: A link from a column or value to a concept. It is approved when it has a reviewer_id.

description.description: Definition of the dataset, column or value.

match_type.description: How the concept relates to the column or value.

provenance.description: Where the link came from, for example the name of a service.

retrieved_at.description: When the link was made, as an ISO 8601 date or time.

reviewer_id.description: Who approved the link. A link without a reviewer is a draft.

Mapping.title: Mapping

MatchType.description: Relation of a concept to a column or value, as defined by SKOS.
MatchType.title: MatchType

description.description: Definition of the dataset, column or value.

identifier.description: Persistent identifier of the dataset. A DOI or URL is preferred.

landing_page.description: IRI of a web page about the dataset.

license.description: IRI of the license, or a statement of the terms of use.

rows.description: Number of rows of the table.

Value.description: A code that the column may hold, with its label.

code.description: The code as stored in the table, as text.

description.description: Definition of the dataset, column or value.

label.description: Human-readable name of the column or value.

missing.description: True if the code means no value.

Value.title: Value
